summary: One action inside violet-menu, with optional before and after slots for an icon or a shortcut hint.

usage.text: It fires invoke, with no detail, on click, and on Enter or Space through its violet-menu. There is no value attribute: identify the item by event.target, an id or a data-* attribute.
A disabled item stays focusable and reachable with the arrow keys, but it fires no invoke and does not close the menu.
Use it only inside violet-menu: keyboard activation, focus movement and closing all come from the menu.

a11y.text: Type-ahead matches the start of the item's whole text content, before and after slots included, so keep the label first in source order and give icons the decorative attribute.
